# TFTP (`tftp`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [Application protocols](../../protocols/app.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 69 (0x0045) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `opcode` | `enum(16)` | `1` (rrq) |   | TFTP opcode (1 = RRQ, 2 = WRQ, 3 = DATA, 4 = ACK, 5 = ERROR, 6 = OACK). |
| `filename` | `cstring` | `"boot.bin"` |   | File name (NUL-terminated). |
| `mode` | `cstring` | `"octet"` |   | Transfer mode: netascii, octet or mail (NUL-terminated). |
| `options` | `list<struct>` — rest of the PDU | `[]` |   | Option name / value string pairs (RFC 2347): blksize, timeout, tsize, windowsize, ... |

### `opcode`

| Value | Name |

| 1 (0x0001) | `rrq` |

| 3 (0x0003) | `data` |
| 4 (0x0004) | `ack` |
| 5 (0x0005) | `error` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `opcode`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| 3 (0x0003) | [`tftp_data`](tftp_data.md) | re-decodes this layer |
